note: The containment ledger, at ZERO (objectui#9910).
This file used to list registrations that render an authored `children` list while
their registry meta omitted `isContainer`, because `validateTree` read that flag for
its `not-a-container` diagnostic (objectui#6779 admitted 44 rows under `undeclared`;
objectui#6804 ruled `button`, `badge`, `alert` and eight `sidebar-*` parts into
`excluded` WITH their ground). The maintainer ruling of 2026-09-24 (objectui#9910,
Q1-A declare-and-pin) moved the contract: a renderer that puts `schema.children` on
the page declares `{ name: 'children', type: 'slot' }` in its registration `inputs`,
`packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts` reads ONLY that input (`acceptsChildren`; there
is no `isContainer` fallback), and `isContainer` means LAYOUT containment only -- the
react-page JSX scope and the public layout ledger read it, the tier does not (Q2-A,
objectui#6804). Every registration that carried a row here declared the slot in that
change, so both maps below are empty.
WHAT HOLDS THE FACT NOW:
packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/container-declaration-ratchet.test.tsx,
the runtime census, over the whole registry and in BOTH directions:
- a registration that renders children and declares no `children` input -> red.
Declare the input on the registration; do not add a row here.
- a declared `children` input whose renderer never puts the list on the page -> red.
Delete the input, or probe the renderer in the context it renders in.
- `not-a-container` firing on a declared slot, or staying silent on an undeclared
one, whatever `isContainer` says -> red. The tier reads the input and nothing else.
A ROW HERE IS AN ADMITTED VIOLATION AND NEEDS A RULING, the way objectui#6779 admitted
the original 44 and objectui#6804 the excluded 11. `undeclared` rows are dated (`since`)
and owned (`issue`); `excluded` rows carry their ground in `reason`. The census keeps
the OTHER direction red too -- a listed row that no longer violates is dead weight and
fails -- so the file can only shrink back to this state. RATCHET TO ZERO, NOT AN
EXEMPTION LIST, and red in BOTH directions, exactly as before; what moved is the
predicate, from a hand-kept flag to a declared input the census executes against.
⚠️ `isContainer` is no longer a way to pay a row off. Declaring the flag changes what
`renderers/layout/react-page.tsx` injects into every `kind:'react'` page (it skips
containers) and what `apps/console/src/__tests__/public-contract.test.ts` lists as a
layout container; it changes nothing about `not-a-container`.
